verdict.rationale: ESD's own guidance says that "employers and firms that represent employers" can manage many tasks in eServices/EAMS, and a guide on adding an employer in EAMS suggests a representative firm can attach client accounts. That is a sanctioned third-party rail, but it is only thinly described. Missing for 10: how an employer authorizes or revokes a representative (e.g., a power-of-attorney or designee form), what a representative is permitted to do, any registry or vetting of authorized providers, and independent or hands-on confirmation, since the authenticated portal could not be inspected.
